title: %lookupDefault — map a key through a table with a fallback
purpose: Translate a value via a declared lookup table, returning a default when no row matches.
notes: The table is declared with a {$table.NAME[col1, col2]} block above the output section.
The first argument is the quoted "TABLE.column" naming the column to return; the keys to match follow.
The last argument is the default value, returned when no row matches (here "wagon" is absent, so "??").
A matching key returns the cell value instead of the default.

avoid.why: the default argument is required; with only the table reference and one key the call has too few arguments and resolves to ~
the "TABLE.column" reference must come first; reversing it with the key matches nothing and returns the default
